summary: Admins get a new Settings page for site-wide configuration, and staff post and page editors now run through a single editor abstraction ready for TinyMCE.
detailed_changes: Added a cached site settings store with typed defaults, starting with the staff editor choice (#250).
Added the admin-only Settings page at /admin/settings with inline validation and an audit log entry on every change (#251).
Added a Settings link to the admin workspace navigation, with access-control tests for guests, members, staff and admins (#252).
Staff post and page editors now render through one EditorField component instead of importing Editor.js directly (#253).
The active editor is shared with staff screens only; the TinyMCE option falls back to Editor.js until TinyMCE ships in v1.12.0 (#254).
Patched laravel/framework, league/commonmark, league/flysystem, axios and qs to clear new security advisories (#317).
affected_areas: User groups affected: admins and staff
Public impact: none; stored content and public rendering are unchanged
Internal impact: admins can manage site settings; editor switching groundwork for v1.12.0
